thread:
alex: Heads-up — PR #9812 (db migration + index change) is blocking the RC. Cutoff in ~90m. We need 2x LGTM before cutoff or we auto-backout. Small schema change, migration is backwards-compatible but can be slow on large tables. Smoke tests passed on staging. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9812. Anyone able to take a second review?

maya: Reviewing now, will check the migration script and rollback plan. ETA ~25m.

jamal: I can take a look in ~15, ping me if you want me to prioritize it.

sara: Quick Q — does this require downtime or is it a background chunked migration?

alex: Background chunked migration, no downtime expected. Worst-case we run the rollback script. I added the rollback at `tools/migrations/9812_rollback.sh`.

ops-oncall: Happy to run the preflight and watch replication lag during rollout. Share the exact preflight command and expected signals.

alex: Preflight: `./tools/migrate --dry-run --pr 9812 && ./ops/preflight-check.sh`
Smoke check example: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST\" https://staging.redwood.dev/health` -> `200 OK`. Also watch `SELECT count(*) FROM migrations WHERE status='running'` on staging.

ci-bot: CI checks: unit ✅ integration ✅ smoke ✅ db-migrate: passed on staging. Sonar: minor nits reported.

jamal: Left a tiny code comment about a missing NULL check in `migrations/9812/step_2.py`. Not blocking but would prefer it fixed before merge.

alex: Pushed a quick fix for the NULL check (force-push). cc @jamal — diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9812/files

jamal: LGTM.

maya: Approved — leaving explicit 2x LGTM here. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks. @ops-oncall can you schedule the preflight start at T-minus 40 pls?

ops-oncall: Scheduling preflight at T-minus 40. I'll monitor replication lag and CPU; will abort if lag > 5s or error rates spike.

alex: Perfect. I'll trigger merge 10m after preflight if all green. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
